literal: You are of good nature, may you live long, O aniccam flower! Even more than you, she is of soft nature, she whom we love.
translation: May you live long, O aniccam flower, for you are of a gentle nature! But the woman I love is even softer than you.
modern: அனிச்ச மலரே, நீ மென்மையான தன்மை கொண்டவள்; நீ வாழ்க! ஆனால் நான் விரும்பும் என் காதலி உன்னை விடவும் மென்மையானவள்.
explanation: The speaker addresses the aniccam flower, which is renowned in classical Tamil poetry for its extreme delicacy, wilting even when merely smelled. He praises the flower's gentle nature and wishes it a long life. However, he declares that the woman he loves is even softer and more delicate than the aniccam itself. By comparing his beloved to the most fragile flower and placing her above it, he emphasizes her unparalleled tenderness.
